extracted.intended_audience: prospective authors/submission proposers to Artisan Books (Workman Publishing imprint)
extracted.subtask_short: book proposal submissions to Artisan Books
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for preparing and sending a book proposal to Artisan Books, describing required proposal components, file formats, submission address, and expectations for fit and review time. Meant to help authors present a complete, professional proposal tailored to Artisan's list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter
rubrics_metrics.description: A cover letter giving a short description of the project and what materials are included in the file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the cover letter concise and clearly list the enclosed materials so editors can quickly see what is being submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal contents (outline, introduction, art list, samples)
rubrics_metrics.description: A proposal, which includes an outline, introduction, art list, and sample text/chapters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear project outline and an introduction that explains the book's concept; include an art list for visual projects and sample chapters or text to demonstrate voice and structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sample illustrations or photographs
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include representative, high-quality samples of artwork or photography if the book relies on visuals; these help editors assess aesthetic fit and production needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market analysis and comparable titles
rubrics_metrics.description: A market analysis of the potential readership for your book, including a comparison to similar books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the target audience, estimated market size, and list comparable or competing titles to show awareness of the marketplace and positioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author biography and credentials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a brief bio emphasizing relevant experience, platform, previous publications, or expertise that support your ability to write and promote the book.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission destination and acceptable file formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Please direct your proposal to submissions@artisanbooks.com. All proposals must be submitted as Microsoft Word or PDF files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send proposals by email only to the specified address and use Word or PDF to ensure editors can open and review your materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review timeframe expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: When submitting a proposal, please keep in mind that it may take up to three months for editors to review it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow up to three months before expecting a response; do not resend or follow up prematurely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess fit with Artisan's current list
rubrics_metrics.description: Before submitting a proposal, please review this site to learn more about our current list and the kinds of books we typically publish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your project aligns with Artisan's existing titles and editorial focus; submissions that clearly fit the imprint's list have a better chance of interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide comprehensive information
rubrics_metrics.description: The more information you can give us to understand your project, the better.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be thorough in your proposal—detailed outlines, market analysis, samples, and author credentials make it easier for editors to evaluate your project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check Workman Publishing imprints and policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Artisan Books is an imprint of Workman Publishing. To view all of the imprints and submission policies, please go to our submissions page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unsure whether Artisan is the right imprint, consult the parent company's submissions page for imprint-specific policies and alternatives.
